description: 50 Pokémon model assets with genuine acquired source geometry and textures. 28 species retain native attacks and use selected native entrance actions; 22 species have explicitly project-authored anatomical skeletal actions. The original 33 models preserve all geometry, textures, nodes, skins and original animations exactly. The additional 17 preserve source geometry and texture buffers; 12 use existing source skins and five use documented anatomical skin transfers. No source clip is mislabeled as an official attack.
rights: Pokémon assets belong to their respective rights holders, included under user-stated license. Source repository code licenses do not grant ownership of Pokémon assets. Preserve embedded Sketchfab uploader attribution; those models claim CC-BY-4.0 in their metadata.
validation: All 50 GLBs decode with idle, entrance and attack mappings, valid skin joints and matching output hashes. Original 33 body assets and original animation data are byte/structurally preserved. Native restored entrance keyframes are exact source copies. Additional 17 geometry and encoded textures match their sources; five documented skin transfers are separate authored rigging. Independent integration checks cover 350 CPU-skinned poses and 315 emitter transforms. Evidence is recorded in docs/research/pokemon-ensemble-animation-audit.json and docs/research/remaining-species-assets.json.

operations: Preserve previously optimized idle/action clips and exact original body assets; append selected native entrance sampler/accessor bytes for 27 models. Retain Charizard native happy unchanged. Add explicitly project-authored ensemble_enter/ensemble_attack on five existing rigs, retaining their original display loops.
Deduplicate buffers and textures. All source node names, exact node transforms, hierarchy, geometry attributes, indices, skin joints and inverse bind matrices preserved.
Resample redundant animation keys with tolerance 1e-7. This is a bounded numeric approximation, not an assertion of bit-identical motion.
Encode smaller textures as lossless WebP only after exact decoded RGBA comparison; preserve all texture dimensions and other image bytes.
Decode pre-existing Draco geometry without re-quantization; output decoded geometry buffers unchanged. No Meshopt or new geometry decoder required.
Restore exact original JSON node transforms after serializer omitted tiny near-identity values.
optimization.validation: All 50 GLBs decode with idle, entrance and attack mappings, valid skin joints and matching output hashes. Original 33 body assets and original animation data are byte/structurally preserved. Native restored entrance keyframes are exact source copies. Additional 17 geometry and encoded textures match their sources; five documented skin transfers are separate authored rigging. Independent integration checks cover 350 CPU-skinned poses and 315 emitter transforms. Evidence is recorded in docs/research/pokemon-ensemble-animation-audit.json and docs/research/remaining-species-assets.json.
optimization.decoderRequirements: EXT_texture_webp uses native WebP support. Existing material extensions remain. No KHR_draco_mesh_compression or EXT_meshopt_compression in outputs.

ensembleAnimation.validation: All 33 existing models retain original JSON body properties, geometry/material/skin/node definitions, original animations, and binary buffer prefix exactly. Native entrance accessor arrays are exact source copies. New authored actions use independent anatomical joints, zero root motion, and idle-pose recovery. CPU skinning validates 165 entrance poses and 50 authored-attack poses; emitter transforms checked separately.

optimization.numericErrorStatisticsScope: Existing resampling and bounds-error statistics above describe the original 33-model optimization. Appended native entrance arrays are bit-identical to archived source. Project-authored actions and five added skin transfers have separate sampled pose checks; no continuous-time error bound is asserted.
